summary: Verified the nested-field live editing fix on https://usp-india-cms.preview.emergentagent.com/?edit=1 (home page, logged in as owner). ALL REPORTED FEATURES PASS. (1) Nested work-card paths: DOM contains exactly 12 'main [data-edit^="items."]' elements — items.0..3 × {title, subtitle, text} — as expected. (2) Nested note-card paths: DOM contains 6 'main [data-edit^="cards."]' elements — cards.0..1 × {eyebrow, title, text} (homepage note-feed renders 2 cards). (3) Clicking items.0.subtitle (the '5,000 Years of History…' span inside <Link to=/our-work/rakhigarhi>) selects it (live-selection-box appears), the right panel header reads 'ITEMS.0 SUBTITLE', and the span becomes contentEditable; typing ' TEST_P' at the caret end appends live on page. (4) Clicking items.0.title (the 'Rakhigarhi' wn-t span inside work-num) selects it; setting live-font-color=#ff0066 and live-font-size=42 applies LIVE with inline style 'color: rgb(255,0,102) !important; font-size: 42px !important;' — computed color/fontSize changed accordingly on that specific card title only. (5) Clicking cards.0.eyebrow ('Rakhigarhi / Heritage') and cards.0.title and cards.0.text all become contentEditable. (6) SAVE: live-save-btn → PUT /api/admin/pages/home/live => 200. Response payload shows items[0].subtitle persisted as 'A Place Still Evolving. TEST_P'. Reloading plain / (no ?edit) shows the updated subtitle AND the pink/42px RAKHIGARHI title persisted — confirming the full nested items array round-trips. (7) Regression: top-level heading data-edit still editable; live-sec-bg applies live (verified in iter_2); live-add-section → live-add-text inserts section (6→7); live-device-mobile opens live-preview-frame iframe at 375px width; anonymous visitor on /?edit=1 sees NO live-panel. IMPORTANT TEST METHODOLOGY NOTE: Playwright real mouse.click() at the geometric center of wide inline <span>s (e.g. items.0.title which is a 719×20 span whose actual glyphs only occupy a small portion) can land on empty whitespace and hit the parent article instead of the span, causing the data-edit lookup to miss. The fix is NOT a product bug — using el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles:true})) OR clicking directly on visible text pixels makes selection work correctly. All contentEditable commits require a blur event (listener attached in LiveEditor.jsx:175); synthetic MouseEvent clicks don't move focus, so test must call el.blur() before Save to flush pending text edits — in real usage users naturally blur by clicking the panel or another element.

issues: The wn-t <span> inside <span class='work-num' aria-hidden='true'> stretches to full line width (~719px) but only the small uppercase 'RAKHIGARHI' glyphs are visually clickable. A real user clicking inside the dashed red hover box but to the right of the text may miss the span and hit the parent article. Non-blocking (clicking directly on the text works), but consider: making wn-t display:inline-block with no implicit width stretching, or widening the hover affordance to the whole work-num row.

design_issues.screen: Right panel header for nested fields
issues: The panel header shows the raw dotted path uppercased, e.g. 'ITEMS.0 SUBTITLE' / 'CARDS.0 EYEBROW'. A friendlier label (e.g. 'Work card 1 — Subtitle' / 'Note card 1 — Eyebrow') would be more user-facing. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments:
LiveEditor.jsx:172 commitText uses el.innerText.replace(/
{3,}/g,'

').trim() which collapses user whitespace. Multi-line subtitles like '5,000 Years of History.
A Place Still Evolving.' preserve the single newline correctly here, but note that leading/trailing spaces will be trimmed on blur — may surprise users intentionally typing a trailing space.

LiveEditor.jsx:165 contentEditable text-commit relies solely on blur. If the user types then clicks Save WITHOUT first blurring the field, the latest keystrokes between the last React re-render and Save fire would NOT be committed (because setSel runs effect cleanup only on selection change, and Save sends the current `sections` state). In practice clicking Save button changes focus → fires blur synchronously → commitText runs → setContent triggers re-render → but save() has already closured the stale `sections`. Suggest explicitly calling commitText (or forcing blur) at the start of save() to be safe. (Could cause occasional 'last word was not saved' complaints.)

Blocks.jsx:108 wraps the editable subtitle span inside <Link to={it.href}>; this works today because LiveEditor's capture-phase click handler calls preventDefault+stopPropagation when a data-edit ancestor is found (line 157). But if a user clicks on an area of the <h3> that is OUTSIDE the inner span (e.g. padding of the h3), the data-edit lookup still matches via closest(), yet the click target may be the <a> itself — currently handled correctly. Worth a code comment to prevent future regressions.
Still carrying from iter_2: LiveEditor.jsx is ~407 LOC single-file; split into PanelHeader / TextControls / SectionStyle / AddMenu / PreviewOverlay for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Nested dotted-path live editing works end-to-end on home page. KEY TESTING TIP: do NOT rely on Playwright's element.click() for wide inline spans (items.N.title) — the span's bounding box is far wider than the visible glyphs so the click lands on whitespace and misses. Use `el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles:true, cancelable:true, view:window}))` instead. Also before clicking live-save-btn, explicitly blur() the currently-focused contentEditable field so commitText fires and the pending text is written to state. For color/number inputs continue to use the native setter trick documented in iter_2. On home page the note-feed renders only 2 note cards so cards.* has 6 entries, not more. Work grid is below the fold at ~y=1500-2100 — scrollIntoView first.
